title: Selection Assay to Identify Desiccation Tolerant Bacteria
author: Dalia Molina-Romero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j4icque

steps.title: Prepare SYP Growth Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare SYP broth with a final pH of 6.2.

substeps.instruction: Combine 10g sucrose, 1g yeast extract, 1g K2HPO4, and 3g KH2PO4.

steps.title: Cultivate Bacteria to Stationary Phase
steps.instruction: Grow bacterial strains in SYP liquid medium until they reach the stationary phase.

steps.title: Harvest and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare a bacterial suspension in sterile water.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells twice with sterile water.
Resuspend cells in the initial volume of 45 ml of sterile water.

steps.title: Quantify Initial Cultivable Cells
steps.instruction: Determine the number of viable cells before desiccation (BD).

substeps.instruction: Quantify cells in quintuplicate using the massive stamping drop plate (MSDP) method in SYP medium plates.

steps.title: Set Up Desiccation Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare sample tubes for the desiccation process.

substeps.instruction: Fill thirty sterile polypropylene tubes with 500 µL of the bacterial suspension per tube.
Cover each tube with a sterile cotton cap.

steps.title: Incubate in Desiccation Chamber
steps.instruction: Expose the tubes to controlled desiccation conditions.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes in a desiccation chamber at 30 °C and 55% relative humidity (RH).
Maintain conditions until water is completely lost (typically after six days, corroborated by constant tube weight).

steps.title: Rehydrate and Count Cells
steps.instruction: Perform cell counting every three days for a period of twelve days after the beginning of desiccation (DABD) using the MSDP method.

substeps.instruction: For samples at 3 DABD: Fill tubes with water back to the initial 500 µL.
For completely desiccated samples (6, 9, and 12 DABD): Add 500 µL of water to each tube.
Allow 40 minutes for re-hydration with occasional shaking before counting.

steps.title: Calculate Bacterial Survival Ratio (BSR)
steps.instruction: Quantify desiccation tolerance using the BSR formula.

substeps.instruction: Calculate BSR = (log AbD + 1 / log BD) x 100, where AbD is the log number of bacterial cells in suspension at any time after the beginning of desiccation and BD is the log number of viable cells before desiccation.
